Hana: Noticing a new tail pattern: short stalls (30-140ms) when a small compaction coincides with host-prefetch handoff. Feels like contention on host allocation path.
Diego: paste a trace?
Hana:
```
[2026-06-01T10:05:00.001Z] worker: req=0x7f stage=ATTN
[2026-06-01T10:05:00.020Z] compactor: request_compact slab=5 size=64KB
[2026-06-01T10:05:00.021Z] offload: demote tenant=acme size=16KB
[2026-06-01T10:05:00.104Z] hostpool: acquire returned after 83ms
[2026-06-01T10:05:00.105Z] worker: resumed
```
Maya: Looks like compactor and offloader both touch hostpool; compaction can transiently increase host alloc latency.
Rory: Short-term: add a compaction_reserve API so compactor asks permission (reserve_compact(bytes)) and backs off if reservation denied. Also add demote_coalesce window to batch tiny offloads.
Diego: Longer-term: introduce QoS classes for hostpool allocations: latency-sensitive requests get fast-path reservations; background compaction uses best-effort bucket. That adds complexity in accounting but could stabilize tail.
Hana: Also propose non-blocking host_acquire with modes {blocking, pending-as-miss, pending-as-placeholder}. Default to pending-as-miss (recompute) to avoid stalls.
Maya: Need strict caps: per-node_pending_bytes and per-tenant_pending_bytes, plus placeholder coalescing for small writes. Instrument metrics: host_pending_bytes, compaction_reserve_rejected, placeholder_coalesce_count, host_alloc_ms_hist.
Rory: Crash/restart: offloader should write a tiny tombstone before background copy so recovery can decide resume vs cancel. Add GC to auto-cancel pending after 20s.
Hana: I'll run a targeted canary with compaction_reserve enabled, demote_coalesce_ms=8, pending_cap=48MB. ops-bot: deploy canary tag=host-qos-compaction-2026-06-01
ops-bot: deploy finished: success on 3/3 canaries
Hana: Initial canary: P99 improved ~40%, but one node showed NVMe write spikes when coalescing batches were larger. We'll lower coalesce batch max and add per-node NVMe health gating.
Diego: I'll own the non-blocking acquire POC and the QoS sketch. Maya: can you write the compaction_reserve API doc and GC rules? Rory: tune canary and alerts. Follow-up in #eng-runtime in 48h.
